mapper.select: select task_id, user_id, content, category, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from todo_task where user_id = #{userId} order by status asc, create_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into todo_task (user_id, content, category, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{content}, #{category}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from todo_task where task_id = #{taskId} and user_id = #{userId}
